subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Navajo Code Talkers
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Navajo Code Talkers.

hook.text: The US Marines used Navajo language as an unbreakable code in the Pacific. Japan never cracked it.

buildup.text: Navajo was unwritten, had no alphabet, and was spoken by fewer than 30 non-Navajo people worldwide.

discovery.text: Code talkers transmitted battlefield orders in Navajo, encoding military terms with nature words.

twist.text: After the war, their contribution was classified for 23 years. They returned home to discrimination.

climax.text: The Navajo language was the only code in modern warfare that was never broken by the enemy.

punchline.text: Their language was the code. Unbreakable.

quiz.question: Why was the Navajo code never broken by Japan?
options: The language was unwritten and spoken by almost no non-Navajo people
The code was changed every single day
